title: RAGForge Outbox to RabbitMQ Worker Contract v1

topology.transactionBoundary: API/domain mutation and outbox record commit atomically.
topology.relay: A relay publishes the persisted event to a durable exchange; relay redelivery is safe.
topology.consumer: The worker consumes an event, applies idempotent side effects, and ACKs only after durable state and derived artifacts are committed.
topology.queueIsolation: Each environment and deployment uses an explicit exchange, queue and DLQ; no shared mutable test topology is implied.

delivery.exactlyOnceStatement: RabbitMQ delivery and this contract do not claim exactly-once processing.
delivery.duplicateRule: A duplicate delivery returns the existing durable result and does not create another revision, artifact, active pointer update or checkpoint advance.

deadLetter.when: A retryable failure exhausts maxAttempts or a permanent failure is classified.
deadLetter.body: References, failure code, bounded redacted message and trace identifiers only.

nackBefore: any durable side effect is incomplete
ackBoundary.checkpointRule: No ACK path may advance checkpoint when any required persistence evidence is false.

observability.redaction: Stable identifiers and error codes are allowed; secrets, credentials, binary content and full document text are not.
